mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notice (target_board, author_id, title, content) VALUES (#{targetBoard}, #{authorId}, #{title}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT n.notice_id, n.target_board, n.title, n.author_id, u.nickname AS authorNickname, n.created_at, n.views, n.is_pinned, n.is_active FROM notice n JOIN users u ON n.author_id = u.user_id WHERE n.target_board = #{targetBoard} ORDER BY n.is_pinned DESC, n.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT n.notice_id, n.target_board, n.title, n.content, n.author_id, u.nickname AS authorNickName, n.created_at, n.views FROM notice n JOIN users u ON n.author_id = u.user_id WHERE n.notice_id = #{noticeId}

SELECT n.notice_id, n.target_board, n.title, n.author_id, u.nickname AS authorNickName, n.created_at, n.views, n.is_pinned FROM notice n JOIN users u ON n.author_id = u.user_id WHERE n.target_board = #{targetBoard} AND n.is_active = 1 ORDER BY n.is_pinned DESC, n.created_at DESC

SELECT n.notice_id, n.target_board, n.title, n.content, n.author_id, u.nickname AS authorNickName, n.created_at, n.views FROM notice n JOIN users u ON n.author_id = u.user_id WHERE n.notice_id = #{noticeId} AND n.is_active = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE notice SET is_active = #{isActive}, is_pinned = CASE WHEN CAST(#{isActive} AS UNSIGNED) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE is_pinned END WHERE notice_id = #{noticeId}
mapper.select: SELECT is_pinned FROM notice WHERE notice_id = #{noticeId} AND is_active = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notice WHERE target_board = #{targetBoard} AND is_pinned = 1 AND is_active = 1
